lines.text: Many learners say: I slept late yesterday night.
Better: I slept late last night.
Say last night. Not yesterday night.
Last! I called her last night.

data.why: Say last night. Not yesterday night.

native.tip: “昨晚”要说 “last night”，不说 yesterday night。

en.tip: The phrase for yesterday evening is “last night”, not “yesterday night”.
